title: Wallet (a monitored chain address)
description: A chain address the platform watches. The ADDRESS IS THE IDENTITY in the schema today: db/schema/pg-schema.sql declares `wallets(address TEXT PRIMARY KEY)`, so there is no surrogate id and a rename of the address would fork the row. `ownership` distinguishes our own wallets from watched third parties, and `portfolio_linked` is the flag that decides whether its balances count toward the portfolio view - the migration plan's phase-5 caution is that this flag must not be inferred from `ownership`.

address.description: Stored in the chain's canonical form (EIP-55 where applicable). Primary key in the SQL schema.

label.description: Non-empty display label (wallets.New refuses an empty one).

ownership.description: Closed set: `self` (a wallet the platform controls) or `external` (a watched third party).

portfolio_linked.description: Whether this wallet's balances count toward the portfolio view.

recorded_at.description: SQL `created_at`; LEGACY ENCODING is text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', not integer ms - see common/time.json.
